parts.name: Left Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the left button of a computer mouse made of ABS plastic, forming the main clickable surface on the left side.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for primary clicking actions such as selecting, dragging, and interacting with software interfaces.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Right Button
parts.Basic_description: This is the right button of a computer mouse made of ABS plastic, located adjacent to the left button.
parts.Functional_description: It is used for secondary clicking actions such as opening context menus or performing alternate functions.
parts.Movement_description: It moves vertically downward when pressed and returns to its original position via a spring mechanism.

parts.name: Scroll Wheel
parts.Basic_description: This is the scroll wheel of the mouse, typically made of rubber for grip and tactile feedback.
parts.Functional_description: It allows the user to scroll vertically or horizontally through content and can also act as a middle button when pressed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its horizontal axis and can be pressed vertically downward.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: This is the main body of the mouse, made of durable ABS plastic, providing structural support for all other components.
parts.Functional_description: It houses the internal electronics, sensors, and provides ergonomic support for the user's hand.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary relative to its internal components but moves as a whole across a surface during use.
